newsitem.title: FINLAND: Enso sees more forestry restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Enso sees more forestry restructuring.

text.p: The world's forest industry is poised for more restructuring this decade, a leading Finnish industry leader said on Monday.

"The only certain thing is that before the end of the decade there will still be significant structural rearrangement within our sector, in Europe and certainly elsewhere too," said Jukka Harmala, chief executive officer of Finland's largest forest industry group Enso Oy.
He did not specify what arrangements he expected or what role Enso could play but said there were many small units in Europe, particularly fine paper producers.

Commenting on a search for a partner by Austrian fine paper producer KNP Leykam -- majority-owned by Dutch KNP BT -- Harmala said, "As a large fine paper producer we have naturally been mentioned", but did not say whether Enso had been engaged in negotiations.
"There is nothing concrete about these things at the moment," he said.
